audit_metadata.stage: Stage 11: Forensic Failure Analysis & Harness Audit
audit_metadata.root_cause_summary: Stage 9 counted single-turn fuzzy criteria substring matches (semantic_pass) as multi-step completions without verifying if the multi-turn chain (Web -> Evidence -> Python -> Synthesis) executed. In reality, Turn 1 in Stage 9 selected Python prematurely on both tasks (multistep_05 and multistep_12) with invalid/hallucinated Python code, and Turn 2 was never executed due to an unhandled AttributeError on trace.status. Stage 10 strictly evaluated all 7 stages of the sequential state machine, correctly diagnosing 0/15 true autonomous multi-step completions.
